## Hands-on session

Participants design a rubric, create an LLM-as-a-judge prompt, and apply it to a practical tool-using agent scenario.

Workshop materials live in the repo under `workshop/`.

[Open the hands-on page](../../hands-on/index.qmd)

Use your own OpenRouter API key. It stays in this browser, and judge calls go directly to OpenRouter.

<!-- TODO: section owner; concrete scenario TBD when agenda/assets land -->

## Expected flow (from ALTA program)

::: {.incremental}
1. Develop evaluation rubric for the scenario
2. Write / adapt an LLM judge prompt
3. Run the judge over test cases
4. Analyse tool choice, parameters, and response quality
:::
